<?php
// Sandbox only: signs the visitor in as the Playground admin when ?autologin=1 is in the URL.
add_action( 'init', function () {
	if ( isset( $_GET['autologin'] ) && ! is_user_logged_in() ) {
		$user = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
		if ( $user ) {
			wp_set_current_user( $user->ID );
			wp_set_auth_cookie( $user->ID, true );
			wp_safe_redirect( remove_query_arg( 'autologin' ) );
			exit;
		}
	}
} );

<?php
// Sandbox only: answers every request to PostHog's hosts locally and keeps what would have been sent.
add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
	$host = (string) wp_parse_url( $url, PHP_URL_HOST );
	if ( false === strpos( $host, 'posthog.com' ) || false !== strpos( $host, '-assets.' ) ) {
		return $pre;
	}
	$body = json_decode( (string) ( $args['body'] ?? '' ), true );
	$log  = get_option( 'sandbox_posthog_sink', array() );
	foreach ( (array) ( $body['batch'] ?? array() ) as $e ) {
		$log[] = array( 'event' => $e['event'] ?? '', 'distinct_id' => $e['distinct_id'] ?? '', 'uuid' => $e['uuid'] ?? '', 'timestamp' => $e['timestamp'] ?? '', 'identity_source' => $e['properties']['identity_source'] ?? '', 'order_id' => $e['properties']['order_id'] ?? '', 'revenue' => $e['properties']['revenue'] ?? '', 'lib' => $e['properties']['$lib'] ?? '' );
	}
	update_option( 'sandbox_posthog_sink', array_slice( $log, -200 ), false );
	return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => '{"status":1}', 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
}, 10, 3 );

<?php
// Sandbox only: a local stand-in for PostHog's browser endpoints at /ingest (PostHog's documented reverse-proxy
// layout). posthog-js itself is fetched once from PostHog's public asset host; flags answer empty; events are kept.
add_action( 'plugins_loaded', function () {
	$uri = isset( $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ) ? (string) $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] : '';
	if ( 0 !== strpos( $uri, '/ingest/' ) ) {
		return;
	}
	$path = (string) strtok( substr( $uri, strlen( '/ingest' ) ), '?' );
	if ( 0 === strpos( $path, '/static/' ) && preg_match( '#^/static/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$#', $path ) ) {
		$file = WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/uploads/posthog-static' . $path;
		if ( ! file_exists( $file ) ) {
			wp_mkdir_p( dirname( $file ) );
			$r = wp_remote_get( 'https://eu-assets.i.posthog.com' . $path, array( 'timeout' => 30 ) );
			if ( is_wp_error( $r ) || 200 !== wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $r ) ) {
				status_header( 404 );
				exit;
			}
			file_put_contents( $file, wp_remote_retrieve_body( $r ) );
		}
		header( 'Content-Type: application/javascript' );
		readfile( $file );
		exit;
	}
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	header( 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' );
	if ( false !== strpos( $path, 'flags' ) || false !== strpos( $path, 'decide' ) ) {
		echo '{"featureFlags":{},"featureFlagPayloads":{},"errorsWhileComputingFlags":false,"flags":{}}';
		exit;
	}
	$log   = get_option( 'sandbox_browser_sink', array() );
	$log[] = array( 'path' => $path, 'bytes' => strlen( (string) file_get_contents( 'php://input' ) ), 'at' => gmdate( 'H:i:s' ) );
	update_option( 'sandbox_browser_sink', array_slice( $log, -300 ), false );
	echo '{"status":1}';
	exit;
}, 0 );
